root_cause: The committed campaign preflight requires an executable staged runner. prepare_phone_stage.py copied the correct runner bytes with shutil.copyfile but did not preserve its executable mode, so `.local/phone-stage/runner` was mode 0644 rather than executable.
fix: Use metadata-preserving copy2 for stage assembly and make executable-mode validation part of committed preparation finalization/tests before any retry.
retry_gate: Commit and review the corrected phone preparation before retrying.
